paite: Pathian thou in amelmate delhzak hen; amah hote leng ama ah taikek uhen.
heading: David phatna La / Nam Vualzawlna La

paite: Meikhu mutmang a a-om bang in, amaute mutmang in; meilum a khuainun azul bang in migilou-saloute Pathian ma ah mangthang uhen.
Midiktatte bel kipaktak in om uhenla; Pathian ma ah nuam uhenla; ahi, kipaktak in nuam uhen.
Pathian pahtawi in la sa unla, amin phat in la sa un; kangtalai a gamdaite paisuakna ding in lamlian ding sungvum unla, amin TOUPA ahi; ama ah nuam un.
Pathian a-omna siangthou a om, pabeite Pa leh meithaite ngaihtuahpa ahi.
Pathian in mi tangkhatte inkuan ah apangsak a, mihentate apikhia a, vangphatna ah apilut hi; helhatte zaw gamkeu ah a-om uhi.
Pathian aw, na mite makai a na hong pawt a, gamdai a na paisuak lai in, Selah
lei aling dupdup a, vante leng Pathian ma ah atakkhia a; Sinai Tang hilhial leng Pathian ma ah, Israel' Pathian ma ah, aling dupdup hi.
Pathian aw, nang vuah tampi na zusak a, na gouluah ding, abah lai in, na hihkip hi.
Na mi omkhawmte'n huai ah panmun akhoh ua; Pathian aw, nang na hoihna in gentheite a ding inn na bawlsak hi.
Toupa'n thu apia, tanchin genmi numeite pawl lianpi ahi uhi.
Sepaihte kumpipate ataikek ua, inn ngaknu'n gallak sum ahawm hi.
Vakhu kha dangka-eng a luan a, akha mong leng dangka-eng te selsel a luan bang in, belam huang kal bang ah om mah le uh.
Bangkim hihthei in huai akumpipate ahihzak lai, Zalmon tang a vukzuk lai bang ahi hi.
Pathian tang Bashan tang ahi a; Bashan tang tuh tang sangpi ahi.
Tang sangtakte aw, Pathian in a-omna ding a atang deih, bangziak a haza a en. Ahi, TOUPA huai ah tangtawn in a-om nilouh ding ahi.
Pathian kangtalai singnih ahi a, asang a sang tampi ahi; TOUPA tuh Sinai Tang a om bang in, huai lak ah mun siangthou ah a-omta hi.
Nang tunglam ah na paitou a, matte sal in na pi a; mihingte a pan thilpiakte na mu a, ahi, helhatte a pan in leng; akiang ua TOUPA Pathian a- omtheihna ding in.
TOUPA ka puak uh niteng a hon puaksakpa, hon hondampa Pathian phat in om hen. Selah
Ei Pathian zaw hotdamna Pathian ahi; TOUPA Pathian ah sihna a pan suahtakna a-om hi.
Himahleh Pathian in amah melmate lu asat phel ding a, gitlouhna a pai zelte lu sam phatak.
TOUPA'N, "Bashan gam a kipan in ka pi nawn ding a tuipi nuai thuktak a pan ka pi nawn ding.
Na khe sisan a na diah theih a, na ui leite'n na doute lak a tan aneihtheihna ding in," achi a.
Pathian aw, na pailaite amu ua, i Pathian i kumpipa mun siangthou a apai lai
nungak khuang bengte lak ah, lasa pawlte apai masa ua, tumging tum pawl in azui uhi.
Kikhopnate ah Pathian phat un, Israel tui nak a pawtte aw, TOUPA phat un.
Huai ah nautum Benjamin avaihawmpa un a-om chiuchiau, Judah miliante leh a-upate uh, Zebulun miliante, Naphtali miliante toh.
Na Pathian in na thilhihtheihna apia a; Pathian aw, kou ding a thil na hon hihsak hihhat in.
Jerusalem a na tempul ziak in Kumpipate'n kipahmante ahon puak ding uhi.
Dangkate sikden in sialluang lak a gamsahangte taihilh in; bawngtal tampi, michih bawngnoute toh kidou ut mi khempeuh ahihzakta hi.
Aigupta gam a kipan in miliante ahong pawt ding ua; Ethiopiate akhut uh Pathian lam a zak ding in akintat ding uh.
Leitung gamte aw, Pathian pahtawi in la sa unla; aw, TOUPA phat in la sa un. Selah
Vante van nidanglai a omte tung a tuangpa mah. Ngai in, a-aw asuah a, A-aw thupitak mahmah ahi.
Pathian kiang ah hatna pia un; athupina Israelte tung ah a-om a, ahatna vandumte ah a-om hi.
Pathian aw, na mun siangthou a kipan in na kihtakhuai ahi. Amah Israel' Pathian ngei in amite kiang ah hatna leh thilhihtheihna apia hi. Pathian phat in om hen.
